name: Connect Direct Internet
summary: Mornington Peninsula/Melbourne dial-up + ISDN + web design/hosting ISP (CDI, Rye VIC, 1997); became part of Chariot Netconnect c.2004.

events.details: Dial-up/ISDN ISP; 1998 homepage 'Copyright © 1997 Connect Direct Internet', 2375 Pt Nepean Rd, Rye VIC, serving Melbourne and the Mornington Peninsula (associated with Rye Computers, ryecomp.com.au).

Still operating a dialup ISP site in 2003; by 2004-05 cdi.com.au read 'Connect Direct Internet is now part of Chariot' (©2004 Chariot Netconnect) - absorbed into Chariot. (Earlier 'defunct c.2002' was incorrect; the site flapped 200/404 through 2002-04 but continued trading.)
